AccountDeletionStatus.description: Deleting while the account can still be restored, until the server deletes the sign-in in Clerk at deletesAt; deleted once Clerk has.

AccountDeletion.description: Every device is revoked and every token refused from the moment this is answered, except to read or restore the account. Signing in again before deletesAt can restore it.

deletesAt.description: When the sign-in is deleted for good and the account can no longer be restored.

AccountDeletionRequest.description: What the phone may send when it deletes an account. The body can be left out.

appleAuthorizationCode.description: A code Sign in with Apple gave the phone moments ago. The server trades it for a token and revokes that, so Apple stops treating the person as signed in to Sikemux.

AccountStatus.description: Active, or deleting: deleted on request and still restorable until deletesAt.

Account.description: Whether the signed-in account is in use or waiting to be deleted.

deletesAt.description: Only while deleting: when the account is deleted for good unless restored first.

restorableDays.description: How many days a deleted account can still be restored: deletesAt is this long after the deletion.

plan.description: The plan the account holds, its own or through a seat; plan.changed says when it changes.

Staff.description: The account belongs to someone who makes Sikemux. Its hosts take each build of main before nightly does, and features still being tried are on for it.

AccountProfile.description: The name, email and picture the account signed in with, for a host to show who it belongs to.

SignInAddressCheck.description: An address the person is about to add as a way to sign in, checked before Clerk sends it a code. It is read and forgotten, never stored.

SignInRemoval.description: A way to sign in the API took off the account because its address is a work address: at a domain an org verified, or already proven on an account.

orgName.description: The org that verified the domain; null when the address was proven on an account instead.

provider.description: The sign-in that brought the address, such as google; null for an address added on its own.

SignInsTidied.description: What was taken off the account since the person last saw it, each told once.

WorkAddress.description: A work address the person proved they hold, kept as a keyed hash: the address itself is never stored, so only its domain is shown.

id.description: Names the proof for removing it.

orgId.description: The org that had verified the domain when the address was proven; null once that org is gone.

verifying.description: Whether a work address can be verified here; false while the API has no Google client for it.

WorkAddressVerifyStart.description: Where to send the person to sign in with the Google account of their work address.

WorkAddressVerifyFinish.description: What Google sent back to the web app after the person signed in there.

WorkAddressProven.description: The work address just proven, and the org its domain lets the person join now, in this sitting only.

sitting.description: Joining the offered org names this, so the join stands on the proof just made.
